_comment: Golden set for `learn topics-for --cue` (memory optimisation O5). Each case is a phase objective as a roadmap would state it, and the shipped universal topics a person would want loaded for it, labelled from the topic names and pattern summaries before the cue ranking was written. tests/learn-cue.test.cjs scores the cue ranking against the size-greedy role ranking on precision and recall. Add cases; do not relabel one to make a ranking pass.

cases.objective: Add a database migration that renames the orders.total column and backfills the new amount column for existing rows
Stream the 2 GB access log, parse each JSON line and aggregate counts per status code
Run independent build tasks in parallel with a dependency graph, a concurrency cap and retries
Write the settings file safely so a crash mid-write never leaves it corrupted
Add a CLI command that reads JSON from stdin and prints one record per line for piping into other tools
Fix slug generation for names with emoji and accented characters
Add role-based access control to the REST endpoints and hide records another tenant cannot read
Store the third-party API tokens without leaking them into logs or commits
Expose the project's tools to coding agents through an MCP server
Return validation errors from the config loader with the path of the field that failed
Copy uploaded images and PDFs into the storage folder without corrupting them
Make the nightly import resumable so a rerun after a failure skips the rows it already imported
Add tests that round-trip the CSV export through the importer
Track down test failures that only happen in CI when the suite runs in parallel
Compute percentiles and normalised scores for the metrics dashboard
Turn the ignore-file patterns such as **/node_modules into matcher rules
Remove the demo data fallback from the live dashboard and show an empty state when the API returns nothing
Wrap the external ffmpeg command and detect when a conversion actually failed
